title: 🔥存量资金避险回流比特币
body: 市场处于存量博弈的避险轮动阶段。BTC.D报58.7%，七日逆势上涨0.3%，显示资金正从山寨币撤出回流比特币。在现价低于200日定投成本的情况下，dominance依然维持高位，说明市场缺乏增量资金，仅靠存量腾挪无法推动普涨。偏空。流动性枯竭何时终结？
title_en: 🔥 Existing Capital Rotates Back to Bitcoin for Safety
body_en: The market is stuck in a risk-off rotation phase, effectively a game of musical chairs with current liquidity. BTC.D sits at 58.7%, climbing 0.3% over the last seven days against the grain. This signals a clear flight to safety as capital exits altcoins and flows back into Bitcoin. Even with spot prices below the 200-day DCA cost, dominance remains elevated. This proves the market is void of fresh inflows—shuffling existing capital simply isn't enough to spark a broad-based rally. Bias: Bearish. When will this liquidity drought finally end?
